hardware_units.MX: Matrix Multiplier Array (Systolic MAC unit, 32 channels wide)
hardware_units.PE: Processing Element Array (Vector ALU, Activation LUTs, Reduction unit)
hardware_units.DMA: Direct Memory Access Engine (DART IOMMU translation, 16KB Tile Fetch)
hardware_units.CCDMA: Cross-Cluster DMA Interconnect (fANE0, fANE1, fANE2 collective ring)

dimensions.P: Pitch (channel plane byte distance, aligned to 16KB tile boundary)
dimensions.R: Row stride (horizontal line byte distance, aligned to 64 bytes)

supported_precisions.name: FP16
supported_precisions.description: IEEE 754 half-precision float (1 sign, 5 exp, 10 mantissa)

supported_precisions.name: BF16
supported_precisions.description: Brain floating point (1 sign, 8 exp, 7 mantissa)

supported_precisions.name: INT8
supported_precisions.description: Signed 8-bit quantized integer with per-channel scaling

supported_precisions.name: UINT8
supported_precisions.description: Unsigned 8-bit quantized integer with zero-point offset

supported_precisions.name: INT4
supported_precisions.description: Sub-byte 4-bit packed weights for compressed generative LLMs

CSNE_CMD_RESET.description: Hardware device reset and state recovery

CSNE_CMD_LOAD_PROGRAM.description: Load program context, bind .hwx task descriptors and allocate L2 SRAM pages

CSNE_CMD_UNLOAD_PROGRAM.description: Unload program context and release L2 SRAM footprint

CSNE_CMD_CREATE_PROCESS.description: Allocate process execution arena and register DART IOMMU page table root

CSNE_CMD_TERMINATE_PROCESS.description: Terminate process execution arena and flush DART mappings

CSNE_CMD_PROCEDURE_CALL.hardware_unit: MX Matrix Array + PE Vector ALU
CSNE_CMD_PROCEDURE_CALL.description: Execute procedure inference request on pre-mapped input/output IOSurfaces

CSNE_CMD_PROCEDURE_CALL_WITH_CUSTOM_BARS.hardware_unit: MX Matrix Array + PE Vector ALU
CSNE_CMD_PROCEDURE_CALL_WITH_CUSTOM_BARS.description: Execute procedure with explicit Base Address Register (BAR) remap table

CSNE_CMD_PROCEDURE_CALL_WITH_SIGNAL_EVEN.description: Execute procedure with hardware-enforced IOSurfaceSharedEvent signaling

CSNE_CMD_LOAD_AFPP.description: Load ANE Fast Path Pipeline descriptor into ultra-low latency hardware register queue

CSNE_CMD_UNLOAD_AFPP.description: Release Fast Path Pipeline context and unbind hardware queue slot

CSNE_CMD_PREMAP_BUFFER.description: Asynchronously pre-map input/output IOSurface buffer into DART page tables

CSNE_CMD_DATA_CHAINING_EVENT.description: Link procedure output directly to subsequent procedure input in L2 SRAM

CSNE_CMD_PREFETCH_DSID_EVENT.description: Trigger asynchronous DMA tile prefetch into L2 cache ahead of execution

CSNE_CMD_SECURE_MODE_EVENT.description: Engage secure mode barrier isolating ANE execution to authenticated memory regions
